name: namefi
description: Search, register, and manage domains and their DNS through the Namefi API (via the hosted Namefi MCP server), plus guided workflows for pointing a domain at a machine with no static IP (dynamic DNS, NAT port forwarding) and serving it over real HTTPS behind Caddy or Traefik.

interface.shortDescription: Search, register, and manage domains and DNS from Codex
interface.longDescription: Namefi turns internet domains into on-chain NFTs. This plugin connects Codex to the Namefi API: check domain availability and pricing, register domains and track orders, read and edit DNS records, configure parking, forwarding, and auto-renew, and find outbound leads for domains you own. It also bundles guided skills for exposing a locally-developed service on a real hostname without a static IP — dynamic DNS, NAT port forwarding, and real HTTPS behind Caddy or Traefik.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether a domain is available and what it costs, register one, or update its DNS records
